verdict.rationale: Mastra documents that projects are free to self-host and that you can 'build and host agents anywhere' on any Node.js-compatible environment. That lets users decide where agent execution state and memory physically live. However, the pack has no explicit data-residency or region-selection feature, no documentation of which storage backends hold data, and no region options for the hosted Studio. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection controls, documentation of configurable storage backends and their location, residency guarantees for hosted offerings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self host your Mastra projects ... Free Apache 2.0 licensed $0/ month ... Build and host agents anywhere
Mastra applications can be deployed to any Node.js-compatible environment.
Mastra uses storage to remember execution state, so you can pause indefinitely and resume where you left off.
